description.value:
You learn to unleash special magical effects with your shots.

Arcane Shot Options. You learn two Arcane Shot options of your choice, and one more at Fighter levels 7, 10, 15, and 18. Each time you learn a new option, you can also replace one option you know with a different one.

Using Arcane Shot. Once per turn, when you make a ranged attack with a weapon that has the Ammunition property, you can apply one of your Arcane Shot options to it. You decide to use the option when you hit a creature and deal damage to it, unless the option doesn't involve an attack roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

Arcane Shot Die. Arcane Shot options refer to your Arcane Shot Die, a d6. It becomes a d8 at Fighter level 10, a d10 at level 15, and a d12 at level 18.

Saving Throws. If an option requires a saving throw, its DC equals 8 plus your Intelligence modifier and Proficiency Bonus.

Arcane Shot Options

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.qjc8gHGgYF1zX2BM]{Banishing Shot}. Your ammunition briefly sends the target to a harmless demiplane. The creature you hit takes extra Psychic damage equal to one roll of your Arcane Shot Die and must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be banished: it has the Incapacitated condition and a Speed of 0, and at the end of its next turn, it reappears in the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.KjB4K9RwPQmvKyBR]{Beguiling Shot}. Your ammunition beguiles the target. The creature you hit takes extra Psychic damage equal to two rolls of your Arcane Shot Die and must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition until the start of your next turn, with you or one of your allies within 30 feet of it (your choice) as the charmer. The condition ends early if the charmer attacks the target, damages it, or forces it to make a saving throw.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.pYKYAJTsbiZReHoe]{Bursting Shot}. You fill your ammunition with explosive energy. Immediately after you damage the creature, it and each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from it take Force damage equal to two rolls of your Arcane Shot Die.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.l5rJZ3eM7davjVy1]{Enfeebling Shot}. Your ammunition saps the target's strength. The creature you hit takes extra Necrotic damage equal to two rolls of your Arcane Shot Die and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn; whenever it hits with an attack roll while Poisoned this way, it subtracts one roll of your Arcane Shot Die from the total damage of that attack.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.y2D7FfmjO95kDDyI]{Grasping Shot}. Your ammunition creates clutching brambles around the target. The creature you hit takes extra Slashing damage equal to one roll of your Arcane Shot Die and must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the Restrained condition for 1 minute or until you use this option again. The target, or a creature within its reach, can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your Arcane Shot save DC, removing the brambles on a success.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.C1FUcYpabqVyl6WS]{Piercing Shot}. You give your ammunition an ethereal quality. You don't make an attack roll; instead, the ammunition shoots forward in a 30-foot-long, 1-foot-wide Line originating from you, ignoring cover as it phases through solid objects, then vanishes. Each creature in the Line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking damage as if it were hit plus extra Piercing damage equal to two rolls of your Arcane Shot Die on a failure, or half as much on a success.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.xCqMOuHGgjtuT1SY]{Seeking Shot}. Your ammunition seeks its target. You don't make an attack roll; instead, choose one creature you have seen in the last minute. The ammunition flies toward it, moving around corners and ignoring Half and Three-Quarters Cover. If the target is within your weapon's long range, it makes a Dexterity saving throw: on a failure, it takes damage as if it were hit plus extra Force damage equal to two rolls of your Arcane Shot Die, and you learn its current location; on a success, it takes only half as much damage. If it is beyond long range, the ammunition disappears after traveling as far as it can.

@UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.classes.Item.pdvOZZw2LaftDj6H]{Shadow Shot}. Your ammunition clouds the target's vision with shadows. The creature you hit takes extra Psychic damage equal to one roll of your Arcane Shot Die and must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

Foundry Note

Each option you learn is a separate item with its activity, which spends a use of Arcane Shot.
